about: The source model of a safetensors file (spec/zarrify/safetensors.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/safetensors.md#53-elements>): the elements a parser emits, the table of data types, and the roles the file, its length, its header and its tensors play, each with the constraints the input must meet (spec/zarrify/safetensors.md §8.2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/safetensors.md#82-checks>). The parser checks them in this order. Projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

types.about: a dtype's bits and Zarr data type (spec/zarrify/safetensors.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/safetensors.md#3-data-types>): every Dtype of the safetensors library

elements.about: The IR of a safetensors file. N is the header's length, B a tensor's data's.

tensors/<i>.extent: (8 + N + begin, B), the header's tensor i, when B > 0
